headline: WEIGHT SURGERY: the honest denominator is live
lede: Stage 1 of the fair-horizon rescore shipped at /retrogames/demos/weightsurgery.html: fixed 100 MATH-500 + 100 GSM8K problems measured at a 4096-token horizon, where answers can actually finish — so the loop-fix claim now has a denominator that isn't a truncation artifact.

notes.text: Base at cap 4096: MATH accuracy 4.0% (≥70% terminate), GSM8K accuracy 11.0% (≥15% terminate) — and only 4–5% of capped answers carry the tight-loop signature. Non-termination at scale is long-windedness, not the MIT attractor.

Token counts on these rows are word×2 estimates (llama v0.3 silently killed the lab's exact counter regex — Surgery II caught it lab-wide), so terminated is printed as a true lower bound and hit-cap as an upper bound. An exact-count rerun refreshes the tables tonight, followed by the edit-vs-base VERDICT (#1506 stage 2).

Both surgery threads merged over each other today without collision — the page now carries round I, round II, and the fair denominator side by side, with the cap-1024 verdict kept visible under a SUPERSEDED banner.
